---
title: "Section 2 class notes"
shift-heading-level-by: 0
---

Notes from section 2's lectures, written by AI models from each class's recording, the
commands typed in class, and the textbook sections the class used. Each model writes its
own set of notes on the same class, so pick any one.

- **Notes:** start here.
- **Review questions:** questions with answers, to test yourself after class. They are
  numbered by level: 1 asks you to recall facts, and the higher numbers ask you to explain,
  use and judge what you learned.
- **Readings:** the textbook sections the class used, with their links.
- **Commands:** what was typed in class, and with its output.
- **Drawings:** diagrams drawn in class.
- **Plaud's summary:** the recording app's own summary.
- **Older prompt's notes:** from an earlier version of the prompt, kept for comparison.
  You can skip these.

AI-written notes can contain mistakes. If something matters, check it against the
textbook, or against the class recording: each topic in the notes gives its time in the
recording, and the transcripts are in the course repository on github.ubc.ca, for the
class only.
